links.outcome: Change in depression symptoms (PHQ-9, EPDS) at 6 weeks, chatbot vs usual care, in an RCT
links.effect: PHQ-9 mean decrease 1.32 (SD 3.4) chatbot vs 0.13 (SD 3.01) usual care; 6-week EPDS and GAD-7 did not differ between groups and were similar to baseline.
links.quote: 6-week mean Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale and Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 scores did not differ between groups and were similar to baseline.

screen.reason: The study is a randomized controlled trial evaluating the feasibility, acceptability, and clinical efficacy of an automated conversational agent (chatbot) app among postpartum patients, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice variation.
